integrity: The local characterization is exact. The asymptotic proof uses a two-range Brun--Titchmarsh/prime-counting estimate and Landau's semiprime asymptotic. Finite enumeration is corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: The result is relative to the squarefree-semiprime stratum and proves only an O(x/log x) bound for its exceptional non-Duffinian subset; no secondary constant for that exceptional set is claimed.
title: Almost all squarefree semiprimes are Duffinian
